blurb: Fraser Cove RIVER FRONT GUEST CABIN is located just off Hwy 99 in Scenic Lillooet BC. Fraser Cove sits on '1200 Feet of Fraser River Frontage. We are beside the historic suspension bridge, built in 1913, which is now open to pedestrians and cyclists. The mountain and river scenery are spectacular!
hoursText: Quiet hours are from 10 PM - 7 AM
